Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, drug_indication.mesh_id AS indication_curie, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind
Join molecule_dictionary ON drug_indication.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Left Join compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Join drug_indication ON drug_indication.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter drug_indication.mesh_heading = 'Multiple Myeloma'
Filter molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1
Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind
